block.label: THE SECRET · ONE QUESTION, ONE ANSWER
block.html:
Ask yourself two questions:

1. Present or past?
2. A complete action / a habit, or an action in progress (-ing)?

Present + habit → Present Simple: She plays the piano every day.
Present + in progress → Present Continuous: She is playing the piano now.
Past + complete → Past Simple: She played the piano yesterday.
Past + in progress → Past Continuous: She was playing the piano at 9 p.m. yesterday.

⚠️ The three traps: ✗ I am play · ✗ I was played · ✗ Did you played?

block.label: ROLE-PLAY · BREAKING NEWS!
block.html: A monkey escaped from the zoo and is now in a shopping mall! One sister is the TV reporter, live. The other is a witness. Then change roles with a new animal (a penguin in a supermarket? a parrot in a school?).

roles.name: Reporter
roles.card: You are live on TV! Describe what is happening right now. Ask the witness: What were you doing when you saw the monkey? What did it do? Does it usually live alone? Is it eating something right now? End with: "Back to the studio!"

roles.name: Witness
roles.card: You saw everything! Tell the reporter what you were doing when the monkey arrived, what the monkey did (it took something from a famous brand store!), and what it is doing right now. Exaggerate!
